name: eslint-plugin-fldlint
description: ESLint plugin that reports (and where provable, autofixes) LaunchDarkly server SDK calls that can migrate to OpenFeature.

scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @fldlint/spec --silent && npm run build -w @fldlint/core --silent
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @fldlint/spec --silent && npm run build -w @fldlint/core --silent
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @fldlint/spec --silent && npm run build -w @fldlint/core --silent && npm run build --silent
